# Mubarak Ismail — Portfolio

> Mubarak Ismail is a cinematographer, photographer, visual effects artist, and contemporary artist based in Abuja, Nigeria.

## About

Mubarak Ismail (mubii) is a multidisciplinary visual artist specializing in photography, cinematography, VFX / color grading, and contemporary art. This portfolio showcases his body of work across these disciplines.
